paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation, featuring a total of six slices. The slices are labeled ENTITYQUEST in blue at 26.0%, HOTPOTQA in red at 24.2%, TRIVIAQA in orange at 22.7%, POPQA in yellow at 21.6%, WEBQUESTIO in teal at 3.6%, and TREC in green at 1.9%. Percentage labels are provided for each slice, and there is no legend included. The chart does not visually emphasize any segments.
